title: Measuring when a press is available
titleZh: 沖壓設備可用時間紀錄
passage:
FARFIELD ASSEMBLY
Utilization note | What belongs in the idle column

The weekly sheet measures time when a press could have taken work but was not being used. Count time in Idle only while a press is available and has no assigned job or setup in progress. The count is not based on whether parts are coming out.

A job's approved setup counts as use from the minute it begins, even if the first piece will not be produced until later. Separately, a press taken out of service for scheduled maintenance is Unavailable, not Idle. A row marked “job ready” tells the planner that a job can start soon; it does not by itself change the press status.

A single time window may contain several statuses. Enter each interval under its actual status. Do not copy the whole elapsed time into Idle just because the same operator was present throughout. The operator may write an explanation in the notes, but the weekly totals use the timed intervals, not the notes.
passageZh:
遠野組裝廠
設備利用率須知｜哪些時間算待命

每週紀錄衡量沖壓設備可以接工作卻未被使用的時間。只有設備可用、沒有指派工作且沒有準備作業進行時，才把時間記在「待命」。是否正有零件產出，不是計算依據。

經核准的工作準備自開始的那一分鐘就算使用中，即使第一件要稍後才會生產。因排定保養而停用的沖壓設備要記作「不可用」，不是「待命」。「工作就緒」標記讓規劃員知道某項工作即將可開始，但單靠這個標記不會改變設備狀態。

一個時間範圍可能涵蓋數種狀態。請將各段時間記入實際對應的欄位。不要因全程是同一位操作員在場，就把全部經過時間放進「待命」。操作員可在註記寫下說明，但每週總數只採計各段時間，不採註記欄。
